citations.evidenceText:
Introduction to Computer Vision

•  Computer vision: A multidisciplinary field that seeks to describe the three-
   dimensional world through two-dimensional imagery and mimic the
   sophisticated visual perception of biological systems.
•  The most fundamental way to define computer vision is as the inverse problem
   of computer graphics.
•  While computer graphics generates realistic 2D images from 3D digital models
   (3D), computer vision attempts to take one or more 2D images & reconstruct
   the properties of the 3D world that produced them.
•  The goal is to describe and reconstruct properties such as:
    – Shape: The geometric structure of objects.
    –  Illumination: The sources and intensity of light.
